links.comparator_used: Simple prompt versus detailed prompt for patient instructions and educational material; the abstract does not say what the detailed prompt contained, so the link to reading-level or audience specification is inferred
links.outcome: Reading grade level of patient-facing output
links.effect: Simple prompts: ChatGPT 4.0 at 10th-grade level, Gemini 1.0 Pro at 7th-grade level. Detailed prompts: both at 6th-grade level. ChatGPT 4.0 reached 85% readability with detailed prompts.
links.tradeoff: ChatGPT 4.0 produced longer outputs with detailed prompts. Outputs from both models lacked guidance on expiration dates and medication disposal, and the authors say healthcare professional oversight is still needed.
links.quote: Both LLMs produced outputs at a 6th-grade level with detailed prompts.

design_hint: detailed prompt design and reading-level constraints
